description: This source file defines a PHP class 'sysinfo' that provides methods to gather system information on Windows NT systems via WMI. It includes functions for retrieving hostname, IP address, OS version, uptime, user sessions, CPU info, hardware components, network stats, memory, filesystem info, and system distribution details.

classes.name: sysinfo
classes.description: A PHP class providing Windows NT system information gathering functions using WMI through COM objects.

methods.name: sysinfo
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the WMI COM object.

methods.name: vhostname
methods.description: Retrieves the server name or vhost, defaults to 'N.A.' if not available.

methods.name: chostname
methods.description: Retrieves the canonical hostname, defaults to 'N.A.' if not available.

methods.name: ip_addr
methods.description: Returns the server's IP address or 'N.A.' if unavailable.

methods.name: kernel
methods.description: Gets the OS version and service pack information.

methods.name: uptime
methods.description: Calculates and returns the system uptime in seconds.

methods.name: users
methods.description: Returns the total number of terminal sessions.

methods.name: loadavg
methods.description: Returns CPU load percentages for each processor.

methods.name: cpu_info
methods.description: Provides details about CPU model, frequency, and cache.

methods.name: pci
methods.description: Lists PCI devices based on PNPDeviceID prefix.

methods.name: network
methods.description: Gathers network interface error and discard statistics.

methods.name: memory
methods.description: Retrieves total and free memory, swap space, and used memory statistics.

methods.name: filesystems
methods.description: Provides information on logical disks including size, free space, and filesystem type.

methods.name: distroicon
methods.description: Returns the icon filename for the distribution.
